note: The cross-modal consistency rules of live generation (p1-live-scenario-generation-s07, LG-09). The code is server/generation/crossmodal.py; this file says the same in words, with the register rows behind each rule. All 53 authored cases pass every rule.

rules.title: ECG rhythm against the pulse
rules.says: An irregular strip (atrial fibrillation) goes with an irregular pulse, a regular strip with a regular pulse.

rules.title: Potassium against the ECG
rules.says: Peaked T waves need a high potassium in the case, flat T waves with U waves a low one; a potassium of 6.5 or more that is not a faulty sample does not sit with a normal strip.

rules.title: Scan against inflammatory markers
rules.says: A scan that shows appendicitis goes with a raised white cell count or CRP when either is reported.

rules.title: Free air against the abdomen
rules.says: Gas outside the bowel goes with a rigid or guarded abdomen on examination.

rules.title: Faulty sample against its repeat
rules.says: A result from a faulty sample is followed in the case by its repeat.

rules.title: Lactate against the patient's state
rules.says: A lactate of 4 or more does not sit with a patient whose starting NEWS2 is 2 or less.

rules.title: Pregnancy test against sex and age
rules.says: A pregnancy test result belongs to a female patient aged 12 to 55.

rules.title: Order of times
rules.says: Observation times do not go backwards and no result has a negative time to result.
